parsed.summary: The PR fixes the incorrect parenthesizing of Subs in LaTeX output, but it may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The change adds parentheses around the expression, which might alter the mathematical meaning in some contexts. It could lead to behavioral regression if other expressions are affected similarly.
The PR does not include any additional tests to verify that the change does not introduce new issues or regressions in other parts of the codebase.
